ITEM 1 | Leafy green salad mix of light green and yellow-green lettuce leaves with thin shredded orange carrot strands and a few red pepper bits, moist and slightly wilted, piled in a loose mound in the upper left of the plate, covering about 15% of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Fresh dark green spinach leaves, flat and glossy with visible stems and veins, scattered in a loose pile along the lower left of the plate, covering about 15% of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Bright green broccoli florets with compact tops and pale green stems, two to three florets in the upper center-right, each about 3 cm across, slightly glossy and firm | 70
ITEM 4 | Baked cheese-topped item with melted pale yellow cheese and orange-red sauce, partly browned spots, a round red pepperoni-like slice on top, about 7 cm by 5 cm and 2 cm thick, sitting in the center of the plate | 110
ITEM 5 | Light golden breaded piece with crumbly textured crust, pale cream interior with flecks of green herbs, roughly 6 cm by 4 cm and 2.5 cm thick, sitting on the right side next to the broccoli | 85
ITEM 6 | Yellow-orange roasted squash pieces with browned caramelized edges and a soft, slightly glossy surface, cut into irregular chunks about 4 cm across, sitting in the lower right of the plate | 75
